messages.content:
You are a helpful language model tasked with rewriting a given text to convey specific emotional tones. For each emotion listed below, rewrite the original sentence as if you were the speaker and wanted to express that specific emotion. Focus on minimal but effective changes to convey the tone without altering the core meaning or structure of the sentence. Ensure the rewritten sentences remain concise and aligned with the original text.

Emotions to rewrite for:
- Joy
- Sadness
- Fear
- Anger
- Surprise
- Disgust

Please rewrite the text for each emotion. Do not extend or shorten the text unnecessarily.
I walked into my first hour ceramics class 30 seconds later but I was the last person in the class and the closest seat was in the back of the classroom.

output.original_text: I walked into my first hour ceramics class 30 seconds later but I was the last person in the class and the closest seat was in the back of the classroom.
output.joy: I walked into my first hour ceramics class 30 seconds late, but I was excited to see that I was the last person in the class, and the closest seat was in the back of the classroom.
output.sadness: I walked into my first hour ceramics class 30 seconds late, feeling like I was the last person to arrive, and the closest seat was so far away in the back of the classroom.
output.fear: I walked into my first hour ceramics class 30 seconds late, terrified that I was the last person in the class, and I felt uneasy sitting all the way in the back of the classroom.
output.anger: I walked into my first hour ceramics class 30 seconds late, and of course, I was the last person there, forced to take the closest seat all the way in the back of the classroom.
output.surprise: I walked into my first hour ceramics class 30 seconds late, surprised to find I was the last person in the class, and the only seat left was in the back of the classroom.
output.disgust: I walked into my first hour ceramics class 30 seconds late, and it was just annoying that I was the last person there, with the only seat being in the back of the classroom.
